title: 差分隐私如何影响大语言模型中的社会偏见？一项系统评估
summary: 本文系统评估了差分隐私（DP）对预训练LLM中社会偏见的影响。通过四种范式（句子评分、文本补全、表格分类、问答）对比DP模型与非DP基线，发现DP在句子评分任务中减少偏见，但该改善不泛化至所有任务。结果表明logit级偏见与输出级偏见存在差异，且减少记忆不一定降低不公平性，强调了多范式评估公平性的重要性。
summary_en: This paper systematically evaluates how differential privacy (DP) affects social bias in pretrained LLMs. Comparing DP models with non-DP baselines across four paradigms (sentence scoring, text completion, tabular classification, QA), it finds DP reduces bias in sentence scoring but this improvement does not generalize. Results reveal a discrepancy between logit-level and output-level bias, and reducing memorization does not necessarily reduce unfairness, underscoring the need for multi-paradigm evaluation.
